plan.notes: Source: official Los Medanos College 'Vocational Nursing Applicant Handbook' (Entering Class - Fall 2025), 'VN PROGRAM COURSE OUTLINE', published by the LMC Nursing Department. The handbook states it 'is revised annually'; it is linked from the official LMC nursing applicant page https://www.losmedanos.edu/nursing/handbook.aspx ('2027 LVN Applicant Handbook' is the current edition; the Fall 2025 edition is the most recent edition publicly indexed). The VN program is a three-semester cohort program; graduates receive a Certificate of Achievement (LMC degree legend: CA = Certificate of Achievement) and qualify for the NCLEX-PN. program_type 'professional-phase': only the professional phase is sequenced here; the handbook states the listed prerequisite courses 'are part of the VN curriculum and are required to apply to the VN Program' and are therefore carried in external_prereqs, not as semesters (handbook prints 'TOTAL PREREQUISITE UNITS 17 or 25'). Per-course prerequisites are not published in the course outline; courses within each semester are taken together as a cohort, so prereq arrays are intentionally empty. VONUR007 is a 1-week intensive course: the handbook outline table carries a 'Units' column whose numeric cell did not extract in text form; the official LMC catalog course description for VONUR-007 (Vocational Nursing Role Relationships, 18 total hours lecture) prints 1 unit, which is encoded here. Semester sums: Pre-1st 1.0 / 1st 13.5 / 2nd 17.0 / 3rd 17.0 = 48.5, matching total_credits exactly.
